release_notes: Agentic Tool Runtime & Cognitive Loop: Autonomous multi-pass tool execution with loop safeguards; ships native session auto-titling (respond_and_set_title), hybrid RRF episodic memory search (search_memory), and live web search with duplex translation for Gemini Live and Deepgram.

Empirical Capability Discovery & Model Probing: Automated endpoint capability probing measuring live TTFT, tokens-per-second throughput, and wire-level tool-calling support across 4,500+ catalog models with tri-state provenance and self-healing cache recovery.

Cognitive Memory v2 & Staging Review: Durable long-term personal profile synthesis with Google Docs-style staging review for approving, editing, and rejecting learned facts; hardened with structured output pre-flight validation and global session compaction locks.

Streaming Audio Pipeline & Telemetry HUD: Real-time chunked audio synthesis across all TTS engines (Kokoro, Supertonic, Chatterbox, Edge-TTS) with sentence-first clause chunking; live turn telemetry HUD tracking exact TTFT, TTFA, and context token utilization.

Theme Interpolation & Desktop Polish: Fluid 200ms theme transitions powered by rAF token interpolation and scoped blur suspension; lazy main webview eliminating first-run double-window flash; hardware-accelerated SVG waveform loader replacing particle overhead.

linux.update_command: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade vox
